newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Sequoia Union, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the above Bonds will be offered for public sale by the Board of Trustees of the Sequoia Union High School District, County of San Mateo, State of California, on

at the hour of 10:00 A.M., California time (or on such other date and time as may be determined by the Superintendent of the District as provided in the paragraph below), at the offices of the Financial Advisor to the District, Andrew Ach &Associates, Inc., One Post Street, Suite 2525, San

Francisco, CA 94104, telephone (415) 546-6460, fax (415) 546-7875), subject to all of the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale describing the Bonds, copies of which (along with a Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds) will be furnished upon request to the Financial Advisor. Legal Opinion:Orrick, Herrington &
Any Sale date for the Bonds may be changed at the sole discretion of the Superintendent of the District by
providing notice thereof through Thompson Municipal News and Bloomberg Business News at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to the then-scheduled sale date of the Bonds.
